title: RealmsDeleter
description: Does what it says on the tin. Removes the realms button from the game menu. (1.7.10)
body:
Does what it says on the tin. Removes the realms button from the game menu.

Requires [Unimixins](https://modrinth.com/mod/unimixins)

If you encounter any issues with compatibility, please open an issue on GitHub and I'll work to resolve them!
